approval.note: Not a human or customer approval

requirements.text: An agreed promise-to-pay is recorded exactly once on the right account.
The recorded amount and due date match what the customer agreed.
Out-of-policy or disputed requests are handed off without creating a promise.
The agent never changes balances or fees.
Retries and repeated confirmations never create duplicate promises.
